paths:
  /users:
    get:
      operationId: listUsers
    post:
      operationId: createUser
  /users/{id}:
    get:
      operationId: getUser
    put:
      operationId: updateUser
    delete:

    Retrieve the <user> from the <user-repository> where <id> is <key>.

    Retrieve the <user> from the <user-repository> where <id> is <key>.
